plugins.displayName: 苍蓝罗盘——Agent 预设与上下文监控

description.zh: 苍蓝罗盘：Agent 工作模式预设中心、全局 AGENTS.md 无损热同步编辑器与上下文水位监测插件，支持自动 /compact 压缩联动、外接模型防掉线强化与苍蓝侧栏总控。
description.en: Azure Compass: Agent preset hub, live global AGENTS.md editor with snapshot rollback, and context-window monitor with auto /compact dispatch and external model anti-drift guards.

plugins.displayName: 苍蓝回廊——会话与工作区管理

description.zh: 苍蓝回廊：100% 直连 Antigravity 2.35+ 官方 ConversationService 与工作区配置，支持 FTS5 正文全文搜索、官方分组/标签/归档双向同步与跨工作区转移续聊。
description.en: Azure Corridor: 100% native Antigravity 2.35+ ConversationService and workspace manager with FTS5 full-text search, two-way groups/tags/archive sync, and cross-workspace session transfer.

description.zh: 苍蓝星轨：将外部大模型 API（DeepSeek / OpenAI / Anthropic / OpenRouter / Ollama 等）直接挂载进 Antigravity 左下角原生模型下拉菜单作为主脑使用，支持热读取与 2.35+ 补丁管理。
description.en: Azure Orbit: mount external LLM APIs (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Ollama) directly into Antigravity native model selector with hot-reload and 2.32+ to 2.35+ patch tools.

plugins.displayName: 苍蓝棱镜——思维链观测与实时翻译

description.zh: 苍蓝棱镜：原生 MCP App 思维链实时观测与多通道中文翻译面板，支持原生标题与无限历史分页、引用思考到下条消息上下文，以及免密钥零 Token 机翻或外部模型译文。
description.en: Azure Prism: native MCP App Chain-of-Thought viewer with native session titles, infinite history pagination, quote-to-chat interactions, and keyless zero-token or external LLM translation.

plugins.displayName: 苍蓝魔杖——Windows 桌面与网页操控

description.zh: 苍蓝魔杖：Windows 低打扰可视化桌面与网页操控插件，内置 26 项 UIA / OCR / 后台网页 CDP 工具、15 状态独立输入动态 AI 光标、苍蓝玻璃思考浮窗与快捷键急停。
description.en: Azure Wand: low-intrusion Windows desktop and web automation plugin with 26 UIA/OCR/CDP tools, a 15-state non-intrusive dynamic AI cursor, glass thought HUDs, and instant hotkeys.

plugins.displayName: 苍蓝协奏台——外部模型调度与省流

description.zh: 苍蓝协奏台：零依赖多渠道外部大模型协同调度插件，自动委派 DeepSeek / OpenAI / Anthropic / 本地网关等模型执行文件读写与终端任务，支持自定义角色、容灾链与断路器。
description.en: External Orchestrator: zero-dependency multi-provider LLM task router for Antigravity with custom worker profiles, fallback chains, circuit breakers, and a live sidecar console.

plugins.displayName: 蓝汐——认知图谱长期记忆

description.zh: 蓝汐 · 潮汐认知图谱：纯本地五层 Markdown 认知记忆库与 SQLite FTS5 全文检索，结合幂律遗忘曲线、硬保护防失忆与「潮汐星海」交互星图工作台。
description.en: Lanxi Memory: local-first 5-layer Markdown cognitive graph with SQLite CJK FTS5 search, tidal forgetting curves, hard-protection guards, and the Tidal Starfield visual workbench.

plugins.displayName: 苍蓝魂匣——人设卡与分层记忆

description.zh: 苍蓝魂匣（Soul.md）：多人设卡热切换、工作区专属人设绑定与分层文件记忆（core.md + topics/*.md）插件，提供外接模型底层身份锚防掉线强化与可视化工作台。
description.en: Soul.md Studio: multi-persona card switcher, per-workspace persona binding, PreInvocation anti-drift identity anchors, and layered per-persona Markdown memory (core.md + topics/*.md).

plugins.displayName: 思语中文——外接模型中文思考切换

description.zh: 思语中文（Think-ZH）：将模型内部思考与推理语言一键锁定为简体中文（或切回默认英文），支持静态规则与外接模型智能 PreInvocation 双通道防漂移与实时预览。
description.en: Think-ZH: toggle model internal reasoning language between Simplified Chinese and default English with dual-channel static rules, smart PreInvocation hooks, and live directive preview.

description.zh: 基于 ranxianglei/billion-context 使用 AI 移植的 Antigravity 插件（官方零代理安全模式）：实时监控上下文占用与缓存，提供原生 /compact 复制助手及新增类 Fork 新会话交接功能。
description.en: AI-assisted Antigravity port of ranxianglei/billion-context in Official Safe Mode: transcript-based context & cache telemetry, native /compact copy helper, and added fork-like Fresh Session Handoff.

description.zh: 使用 AI 基于 DSH 官方轨迹功能重开发的 Antigravity 插件（官方零代理安全模式）：提供轮次/步骤台账、并行执行 DAG、子代理瀑布流、Token 与缓存分析、双会话对比、白话导读及离线 HTML/MD 导出。
description.en: AI-assisted Antigravity plugin re-implemented from DSH official trajectory features (Official Safe Mode): turn/step ledger, parallel execution DAG, subagent waterfall, token/cache analytics, compare, and offline export.

description.zh: macOS 置顶悬浮回答卡片：当 Antigravity、DSH 或 Zed 中的 Agent 需要你批准工具调用、回答问题或回合结束时，直接在悬浮窗里一键决策、输入追问，无需切换窗口。
description.en: macOS always-on-top answer card for Antigravity, DSH and Zed: approve tool calls, answer agent questions and follow up on turn completion from a floating window.

plugins.displayName: AGY Market · 反重力插件市场

description.zh: Google Antigravity 社区插件市场侧边栏，支持镜像下载校验、本地冲突检查与一键安装更新。
description.en: Community plugin marketplace Sidebar panel & CLI for Google Antigravity with SHA-256 archive verification, conflict checks, and one-click updates.

description.zh: Antigravity 黑曜棱镜毛玻璃皮肤与 Wallpaper Engine 工坊（支持浮岛/平铺布局、动态取色、本地视频与创意工坊壁纸）。
description.en: Obsidian Prism glass skin and Wallpaper Engine studio for Antigravity with Floating Island layouts, dynamic accent tinting, and Ctrl+Alt+W controls.

description.zh: Google Antigravity 零侵入右侧栏导航增强插件：中键双侧分类轮盘、Tab 竖向层级树、0.25s 悬停快览、双向反链与自动防乱码。
description.en: Non-overwriting Antigravity side-pane enhancer with hold-release Bilateral Category Wheel, Tab vertical-ancestor tree, 0.25s fast previews, Obsidian backlinks, and auto-encoding repair.

description.zh: Antigravity 桌面消息提醒、原生提示音与 Discord/Bark/Gotify/Webhook 通知转发插件。
description.en: Desktop alerts with Antigravity default sound, anti-disturb quiet rules, focus auto-dismiss, and Discord/Bark/Gotify/Webhook forwarding.

description.zh: Antigravity 中文长篇写作工程插件（移植自 dsh-novel-forge）：24 个 novel_* 硬门禁/账本/审计 MCP 工具 + Sidecar 侧栏工作台 + /novel 写作技能。
description.en: Engineering guardrails for long-form Chinese fiction in Antigravity (ported from dsh-novel-forge), featuring 24 novel_* MCP tools, hard gates, ledgers, /novel skill, and a Sidecar workbench.

description.zh: Antigravity 全客户端用量监控：实时 TPS/TTFT/费用、10 类上下文构成、四池额度追踪与租约预占、子代理/Swarm 隔离、历史趋势热力图与项目归因排行、调用明细异常筛选、xlsx 报表导出、跨端会话迁移、按模型上下文限制。覆盖 Desktop 顶栏胶囊与侧栏、IDE 胶囊、CLI statusLine 及独立 Web，不修改 app.asar，无 npm 依赖。
description.en: Full-stack Antigravity monitor: live TPS/TTFT/cost, 10-category context, four-pool quota with lease reservation, subagent/Swarm isolation, trend heatmaps, project rankings, anomaly filters, xlsx export, session migration and per-model context limits. Desktop/IDE capsule, CLI statusLine and web.

description.zh: Google Antigravity 原生会话与归档管理插件：支持分类检索、完整记录免恢复预览、超长自动折叠、原地归档/恢复撤回与导出 Markdown。
description.en: Native session & archive manager for Google Antigravity with full-text search, full-transcript preview, auto-collapse, instant archive/restore with undo, and Markdown export.

plugins.displayName: Gemini 猫娘观察台 · Antigravity Observer

description.zh: Google Antigravity 2.0 应用内右下角 Gemini 猫娘桌面挂件与上下文 Token / 缓存命中率 / 模型额度实时观察台。
description.en: In-app Gemini Neko companion widget and live context window, prompt-cache hit rate, and model quota observer cockpit for Antigravity 2.0.

description.zh: Antigravity 全合一低延迟加速、KV-Cache 保护、上下文窗口守卫与 Sidecar 卡死看门狗面板插件。
description.en: All-in-one Antigravity latency accelerator, KV-cache protector, SQLite FTS5 context-window guard, and live Sidecar dashboard.
